name: MonarchAiModelPicker
title: AiModelPicker
wrapsNative: MonarchButton that opens an androidx.compose.material3.ModalBottomSheet holding an androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn of selectable rows with an androidx.compose.material3.RadioButton mark, provider headings and MonarchBadges
summary: A button showing the current AI model that opens a sheet of models grouped by provider, with capabilities, context size, speed, cost and the state of the provider key.
whenToUse: When people may choose which model answers, for example in a prompt toolbar or a conversation's settings.
whenNotToUse: For a short list of plain choices without details use MonarchSelect. For the assistant's mode (chat, research, agent) use MonarchAiModeSwitcher.
api: @Composable public fun MonarchAiModelPicker(selection: String?, models: List<MonarchAiModelOption>, onSelectionChange: (String) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, size: MonarchButtonSize = MonarchButtonSize.Md, enabled: Boolean = true, trailingIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchAiModelPickerLabels = MonarchAiModelPickerLabels(), interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null, onConfigureKey: ((MonarchAiModelOption) -> Unit)? = null)

public class MonarchAiModelOption(id: String, provider: String, name: String, description: String? = null, capabilities: List<MonarchAiModelCapability> = emptyList(), contextTokens: Long? = null, speed: MonarchAiModelSpeed? = null, costTier: Int? = null, requiresKey: Boolean = false, keyConfigured: Boolean = false, enabled: Boolean = true)
public enum class MonarchAiModelCapability { Vision, Tools, Reasoning, Web }
public enum class MonarchAiModelSpeed { Fast, Balanced, Slow }

public class MonarchAiModelPickerLabels(label: String? = null, placeholder: String? = null, capability: ((MonarchAiModelCapability) -> String?)? = null, context: ((formatted: String) -> String)? = null, speed: ((MonarchAiModelSpeed) -> String?)? = null, cost: ((tier: Int) -> String)? = null, ownKey: String? = null, keyNeeded: String? = null, addKeyHint: String? = null, unavailable: String? = null, done: String? = null)

options.name: selection
options.description: The id of the selected model, null for none.

options.name: models
options.description: The models in display order, grouped by provider in first-seen order.

options.name: onSelectionChange
options.description: Called with the id of the chosen model; the sheet closes.

options.name: size
options.description: The height and padding of the button.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the button opens the sheet.

options.name: trailingIcon
options.description: An icon at the end of the button, such as a chevron. Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: The source of the button's interactions.

options.name: onConfigureKey
options.description: Runs when a model whose key is missing is chosen, to add the key. Without it such models cannot be chosen.

states.name: placeholder
states.description: No model selected, or an unknown id: the button reads "Choose a model" in muted text.

states.name: selected
states.description: The button shows the model and its provider; in the sheet the row's radio mark is on and the row is selected.

states.name: your key
states.description: A model on a configured workspace key shows a success "Your key" badge.

states.name: key needed
states.description: A model whose key is missing shows a warning "Key needed" badge; choosing it calls onConfigureKey.

states.name: unavailable
states.description: A disabled model, or one whose key cannot be added, uses the disabled text role and cannot be chosen.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The button uses the disabled colors and does not open.

appearance: The button is the secondary MonarchButton with the name in default text and the provider in muted text. The sheet is on the surface color: names in strong body text, details muted captions, capabilities info badges, key badges success or warning, the radio mark in the strong accent role; unavailable rows use the disabled text role. Every color is a theme role, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: Same parameters as iOS: selection becomes a value with onSelectionChange in place of a Binding, isKeyConfigured is keyConfigured, and isDisabled is enabled (true by default) as in MonarchSelectOption and Material 3. The web opens a popover listbox with arrow-key navigation and typeahead; Android, like iOS, opens a list in a Material 3 ModalBottomSheet, because a DropdownMenu cannot show badges and several lines per model. The selected model has a RadioButton mark where iOS has a check mark. The web's controlled open state is not offered; the button owns the sheet. Monarch bundles no icons, so the web's chevron and lock are a trailingIcon slot or left out; key state is always a word in a badge. The composable is experimental: an AI pattern that waits for a Rook app to adopt it.
accessibility: The button is named "Model" and its state is the selected model and provider, or "Choose a model".
The sheet has the heading "Model" and each provider is a heading.
Each model is one row with the radio button role, read as its name, key badge, description, capabilities, context and speed, with the cost in words ("Cost: high"), never the dollar signs.
The selected model is selected and shows a filled radio mark, so selection is not color alone.
A model whose key is missing reads "Select to add an API key."; one that cannot be chosen is disabled and reads "Unavailable".
Rows and Done have 48dp touch targets; text wraps at large font sizes.
edgeCases: A selection id that matches no model shows the placeholder.
Without onConfigureKey a model needing a key is shown but disabled.
Context sizes are compact in the current locale with at most one decimal: 32 768 tokens is "32.8K".
A cost tier outside 1 to 3 is clamped.
Empty models give a sheet with only the heading and Done.

examples.title: Bring your own key
examples.setup:
var modelId by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
var needsKey by remember { mutableStateOf<MonarchAiModelOption?>(null) }
examples.code:
MonarchAiModelPicker(
    selection = modelId,
    models = listOf(
        MonarchAiModelOption(id = "hosted", provider = "Workspace", name = "Hosted model", requiresKey = true),
    ),
    onSelectionChange = { modelId = it },
    size = MonarchButtonSize.Sm,
    onConfigureKey = { model -> needsKey = model },
)
